block.spreadsheet_file.model.title: Spreadsheet File
block.spreadsheet_file.model.description: Read XLSX/CSV files into JSON rows and write JSON rows to XLSX/CSV.
block.spreadsheet_file.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.spreadsheet_file.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_operation: read turns the file input into JSON rows; write turns the rows input into a new XLSX or CSV file.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_allowed_root: Read boundary. Empty uses the application directory; relative input paths start here and resolved files must stay inside.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_sheet: Worksheet name (exact, case-sensitive). Read: selects this worksheet; empty uses sheet_index. Write: names the created worksheet; empty uses Sheet1.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_sheet_index: Worksheet position (1 = first) used when sheet is empty. Chart sheets are not counted.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_header_row: Row holding the column names; rows above it are skipped. 0 means no header: rows are emitted as arrays.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_format: Output format. Reading detects the format from the file extension (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv, .txt).
block.spreadsheet_file.help_output_direc: Existing destination directory. Empty uses this node's persistent storage (spreadsheets folder). Relative paths start at the application directory.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_file_name: File name; the format extension is added. Placeholders: {date} and {time} (UTC), {unique} (random).
block.spreadsheet_file.help_overwrite: Replace an existing regular file with the same name. Off: an existing name fails and nothing is replaced.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_columns: Column order, e.g. ["id","name"]. Other keys are left out and reported. Empty keeps the order in which keys first appear.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_header: Write the column names as the first row.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_on_error: fail stops this node with an error. route publishes a content-free error document on the error port instead.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_skip_empty_r: Leave out rows without any value; they are counted in the report.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_on_limit: When max_rows or max_columns is exceeded: fail, or keep the first rows/columns and flag the truncation in the report.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_allow_macro_: Accept .xlsm or macro-carrying workbooks. Macros are never run or kept; only cell values are read.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_formula_guar: CSV only. escape prefixes text starting with = + - @ tab or carriage return with an apostrophe; reject fails; off writes it unchanged.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_delimiter: CSV field separator for reading and writing. It is never guessed.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_encoding: CSV text encoding. utf-8-sig accepts an optional BOM when reading and writes one, as spreadsheet software expects.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_max_rows: Maximum data rows read, or rows written.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_max_bytes: Maximum size in bytes of the source file, the rows input and the generated file.
block.spreadsheet_file.help_timeout_sec: Deadline for one operation, in seconds. Opening a workbook is not interruptible.
